summary: {person} pays rent on an apartment while an official residence stands available.
realLife: Jerry Brown chose a rented apartment over the residence California had prepared for its governor.
inGame: needs: occupancy and costs of an official residence.

turns.what: The governor moves into the residence.
turns.pulledBy: The family accepts the accommodation and the building is ready.
turns.writesBack: The occupancy record gives the move date.

turns.what: The executive uses the house for official receptions only.
turns.pulledBy: The family keeps its existing home.
turns.writesBack: The property calendar records public functions without residential occupancy.
